chunks.title: About me
chunks.text: Hi, I'm Bibek Koirala. Computer vision and machine learning engineer completing an M.S. in Computer Science at Southern Illinois University Carbondale, with my thesis defended in September 2026. I build detection and segmentation systems for real-world images, which now spot E. coli and Salmonella after just 2 hours of incubation, and I've published at IEEE ICMLA, EMNLP and the Journal of Food Protection. I also build free AI tools and games that run entirely on your own device.

chunks.title: Instance-Level Bacteria Detection and Segmentation
chunks.text: Deep learning for early detection of E. coli and Salmonella in time-stamped microscopy images, on plain agar and on an onion food matrix. A background-aware Mask R-CNN and FPN pipeline detects both species after 2 hours of incubation, against 18–24 hours for a plate count, at mAP@0.5 of about 0.95 and mIoU of 0.91–0.98. Published at IEEE ICMLA 2025 (oral) and extended in my M.S. thesis, where a compact ResNet-based model matched larger SAM and DINOv3 models at 8.1 ms per image, 22× faster than the SAM-based model.

chunks.title: On-Device AI Tools
chunks.text: A free suite of tools with no accounts and no uploads, because the work happens on your own device. LocalLabel annotates images and video for machine learning, with AI pre-labeling from any ONNX model. Document Reader reads files aloud offline in up to 31 languages. Media Studio edits images and video and makes Whisper subtitles. There is also a PDF Editor, a receipt-scanning Financial Planner and Vitrine, digital signage for your own PC. Built with ONNX Runtime Web, WebGPU, WebAssembly and Transformers.js.

chunks.title: Browser Games
chunks.text: Five free games that run in the browser on a phone or computer, with no sign-up. AR Survival is steered by your head through real-time MediaPipe face tracking. Ludo and Snakes & Ladders play on one device or across phones over peer-to-peer WebRTC, with house rules and an optional three.js 3D board. Grave Mistake is a 24-level trap platformer, and Stack Tower is a one-tap arcade game.

chunks.title: SeekBot - Precision Retrieval AI
chunks.text: A full-stack RAG chatbot that lets you chat with your own documents. Upload PDFs, Word files, CSVs, or paste a URL - SeekBot indexes your content into a local FAISS vector store and answers questions using a 10-node LangGraph pipeline backed by HuggingFace LLMs (Llama 3.1 8B / Qwen 2.5 72B). Fully local embeddings, persistent sessions, and real-time model switching.

chunks.title: Plant Disease Detection: CNN vs. ResNet vs. ViT
chunks.text: Benchmarked a custom CNN, a fine-tuned ResNet50, a vanilla ResNet and a Vision Transformer on PlantVillage, reaching 97.9% to 99.6% accuracy and weighing accuracy against model size for deployment.

chunks.title: Inflation Dynamics, Remittances, and Macroeconomic Indicators
chunks.text: Conducted an in-depth economic analysis of inflation trends in countries with high remittance-to-GDP ratios. Using cross-country macroeconomic data from 1960–2023, this project applied statistical and machine learning techniques — including regression models, random forests, neural networks, and clustering — to understand how remittances, real interest rates, and exchange rates interact with inflation.

chunks.title: Leave and Training Records Dashboard

chunks.title: News Credibility Detection
chunks.text: An NLP and machine learning framework that classifies news articles using linguistic, semantic and source-based features, achieving 97% precision and 98% recall on benchmark datasets.

chunks.title: Multi-Label Comment Classification
chunks.text: Explored multi-label text classification methodologies for categorizing user comments across multiple thematic or sentiment dimensions. This repository applies techniques such as feature extraction, neural networks, and advanced evaluation metrics to handle overlapping or concurrent labels in textual data.

chunks.title: Real Time Face and Emotion Detection
chunks.text: This project implements a lightweight YOLOv8 model for real-time face detection and evaluates CNN, vanilla ResNet, and fine-tuned ResNet architectures for emotion recognition, achieving under 50 ms inference with fewer than 1.3 M parameters and model size below 5 MB for fast deployment.

chunks.title: Victim Crime Perception Analysis
chunks.text: Conducted data-driven analysis of crime perception among victims, using statistical and machine learning tools to identify patterns, correlations, and key factors influencing perceptions of crime. This work blends sociological insight with computational analysis to better understand human responses and sentiment in crime-related datasets.

chunks.title: Free tools

chunks.title: Media Studio

chunks.title: Vitrine
chunks.text: Vitrine: Digital signage that runs on your own PC. Build playlists, schedule them, and show them on any screen with a browser. Windows download; your data stays on your PC.

chunks.title: Document Reader
chunks.text: Document Reader: Hear PDF, Word, EPUB, PowerPoint, Excel, text and scanned files read aloud at up to 3× speed. Choose from five open voice models, in up to 31 languages. A voice downloads once, then works offline.

chunks.title: Texlume
chunks.text: Texlume: A free LaTeX editor with a live PDF side by side. TeX Live compiles in your browser with figures, BibTeX, TikZ and two-way SyncTeX. Projects are saved on your device, never uploaded, and work offline after the first load.

chunks.title: Free games
chunks.text: Quick, lightweight games that run right in your browser. 100% free, No sign-up, Phone & desktop, Scores saved on your device. Games: Stack Tower, AR Survival, Ludo, Snakes & Ladders, Grave Mistake.

chunks.title: AR Survival

chunks.title: Ludo

chunks.title: Snakes & Ladders
chunks.text: Snakes & Ladders: A new random board every game, in cardboard, wood or 3D style, with optional captures and house rules, and snakes that swallow, whip and slide you back down. For 2 to 6 players on one device, or across phones by QR code, room code or IP address.

chunks.title: Résumé summary
chunks.text: Computer vision and machine learning engineer completing an M.S. in Computer Science (4.0 GPA, expected Dec 2026). Built end-to-end object detection and instance segmentation pipelines on real-world, custom-annotated image data, from dataset curation and annotation through training, evaluation, and inference (mIoU 0.91–0.98, mAP@0.5 ≈ 0.95). First-author paper at IEEE ICMLA 2025 (oral), plus EMNLP 2026 and Journal of Food Protection publications. Also builds privacy-first ML applications that run entirely on the user’s device, deploying detection, segmentation, speech recognition, and text-to-speech models in the browser with ONNX Runtime Web, WebGPU, and WebAssembly. Brings 5+ years of software R&D delivering real-time, mission-critical numerical software.

chunks.title: Graduate Research Assistant
chunks.text: Graduate Research Assistant, Computer Vision – Southern Illinois Univ. Carbondale, Aug 2024 – May 2026 Department of Computer Science, Carbondale, IL | Funded by USDA-NIFA Grant No. 2024-70001-43667. Built an end-to-end instance segmentation and classification pipeline in PyTorch for time-stamped microscopy images of bacterial cultures, covering data curation, CVAT annotation, training, evaluation, and inference; achieved mIoU of 0.91 to 0.98 across growth stages. Designed a background-aware approach that stays robust across varying imaging backgrounds, enabling detection of E. coli and Salmonella Typhimurium after 2 hours of incubation (previous best: 3 hours) at mAP@0.5 of approximately 0.95; first-author paper and oral presentation at IEEE ICMLA 2025. Contributed deep learning methods to a phase-contrast imaging study for rapid Salmonella detection, published in the Journal of Food Protection (2026). Co-authored an EMNLP 2026 multilingual benchmark for localizing generative image edits, working with vision-language and generative models. Released the framework as open source (github.com/vbek/bacteria-detection) and presented results to interdisciplinary computer science and food science audiences.

chunks.title: LocalLabel: In-Browser ML Annotation Tool with AI Assist
chunks.text: LocalLabel: In-Browser ML Annotation Tool with AI Assist – bibek-koirala.com.np/tools/locallabel. Built a fully client-side image and video annotation tool (boxes, polygons, masks, keypoints, keyframe-interpolated video tracks, TIFF/GeoTIFF support) as a private, install-free alternative to CVAT, exporting COCO, YOLO, CVAT, and Pascal VOC. Implemented model-agnostic AI pre-labeling: runs any user-supplied ONNX model on WebGPU with WebAssembly fallback in a Web Worker, and decodes YOLO, YOLO-seg, semantic, instance-mask, and Mask2Former-style outputs into editable annotations.

chunks.title: On-Device AI Tools Suite
chunks.text: On-Device AI Tools Suite – bibek-koirala.com.np/tools. Document Reader: offline, multilingual text-to-speech for PDF, Word, EPUB, PowerPoint, Excel, and scanned files, serving 4 ONNX TTS model families (Kokoro-82M, Piper, KittenTTS, Supertonic) with custom grapheme-to-phoneme processing, up to 31 languages and 3× playback speed. Media Studio: on-device Whisper subtitle generation via Transformers.js (WebGPU with a 4-bit quantized decoder, or WebAssembly), plus batch image and video conversion, compression, and trimming. AR Survival: webcam-controlled game driven by real-time MediaPipe face tracking, with each vision model isolated in its own worker to keep tracking latency low. Also built a PDF editor (pdf.js, pdf-lib), a receipt-scanning finance planner (Tesseract OCR), and multiplayer board games over peer-to-peer WebRTC with three.js 3D rendering; all tools process data locally with no uploads.
